paragraphs: Rabbi Berekhiah bar Abba bar Kahana, in the name of Rabbi Elazar: Midrash Naso, chapter 9. That matter is in the Jerusalem Talmud, Sotah chapter 3, halakhah 4: “Rabbi Berekhiah, Rabbi Abba bar Kahana, in the name of Rabbi Eliezer.” So too it appears in Eikhah Rabbah, verse “Her impurity is in her skirts”: Rabbi Berekhiah in the name of Rabbi Abba bar Kahana.
